text_en: A Song. A Psalm of David.
My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make melody. Awake, my soul!
text_cn: 天主，我的心已准备妥当， 我的心已准备妥当， 我愿意去歌弹咏唱。

text_en: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awake the dawn.
text_cn: 我的灵魂，你要醒起来！ 七弦和竖琴，要奏起来！ 我还要把曙光唤起来。

text_en: I will give thanks to you, O Lord , among the peoples, and I will sing praises to you among the nations.
text_cn: 上主，我要在万民中赞美你， 上主，我要在列邦中歌颂你。

text_en: For your steadfast love is higher than the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
text_cn: 因为你的大爱高越诸天， 你的忠信直达霄汉。

text_en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, and let your glory be over all the earth.
text_cn: 天主，愿你在天上备受举扬， 愿你在地上彰显荣光，

text_en: Give victory with your right hand, and answer me, so that those whom you love may be rescued.
text_cn: 为叫你所爱的人获得救恩， 求你以右手协助，垂允我们。

text_en: God has promised in his sanctuary: “With exultation I will divide up Shechem, and portion out the Vale of Succoth.
text_cn: 天主在自己的圣所说： “我要凯旋，将舍根分疆， 将稣苛特的平原测量。

text_en: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet; Judah is my scepter.
text_cn: 基肋阿得地属于我， 默纳协地也属于我， 我的头盔就是厄法辣因， 犹大成为我手中的权棍。

text_en: Moab is my washbasin; on Edom I hurl my shoe; over Philistia I shout in triumph. ”
text_cn: 摩阿布是我的沐浴池， 我向厄东投我的鞋只， 我还要战胜培肋舍特。”

text_en: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
text_cn: 谁领引我进入坚城， 谁领导我走进厄东？

text_en: Have you not rejected us, O God? You do not go out, O God, with our armies.
text_cn: 天主，莫非你已将我们抛弃， 天主，难道不率领我军出击？

text_en: O grant us help against the foe, for human help is worthless.
text_cn: 求你援助我们抵抗仇雠(chóu)，因为人的援助尽属虚无。

text_en: With God we shall do valiantly; it is he who will tread down our foes.
text_cn: 我们倚靠天主，奋勇行事。 他必要踏践我们的仇敌。
